entities.name: IFSC Banking Units (IBU / IBC)
entities.profile: Branches and subsidiaries of Indian and foreign banks operating in the IFSC.

entities.name: Finance companies and units
entities.profile: Lenders, lessors of aircraft and ships, factors and group treasury centres registered as finance companies or finance units.

entities.name: Fund management entities
entities.profile: Managers of venture capital, restricted and retail schemes, portfolio management, investment trusts and family investment funds.

entities.name: Capital market intermediaries and listed issuers
entities.profile: Broker dealers, clearing members, rating agencies, custodians, advisers, investment bankers and issuers listed on IFSC exchanges.

entities.name: Insurance offices and intermediaries
entities.profile: IFSC insurance offices, reinsurance branches, brokers, managing general agents and other insurance intermediaries.

updates.title: All IFSC entities to act on CERT-In advisories and vulnerability notes
updates.applies: All regulated entities, including systems run for them by the parent or third parties.
changes: Comply with CERT-In advisories and vulnerability notes, including for systems run by the parent or vendors.
Set up a tracking mechanism within 30 days; assessment and patching duties apply to advisories issued from 25-11-2026.
Reminds entities that CERT-In's own directions (6-hour incident reporting, 180-day logs) apply independently.

ibu.text: Set up tracking of CERT-In advisories, covering systems run by the parent or vendors.

fc.text: Set up tracking of CERT-In advisories, covering systems run by the parent or vendors.

fme.text: Set up tracking of CERT-In advisories, covering systems run by the parent or vendors.

cmi.text: Set up tracking of CERT-In advisories, covering systems run by the parent or vendors.

ins.text: Set up tracking of CERT-In advisories, covering systems run by the parent or vendors.

actions: Assign an owner to track CERT-In advisories and record the action taken on each.

updates.title: Deadline for FME certification courses extended to 31-12-2026
updates.applies: KMPs and specified employees of fund management entities.
changes: KMPs and employees have until 31-12-2026 to complete the specified certification course (ICSI or ICAI).

fme.text: Make sure KMPs and staff finish the course by 31-12-2026.

actions: List staff who still need the certification and book them on a course.

updates.title: Fund management entities must keep a website or webpage from 01-12-2026
updates.applies: All FMEs.
changes: Authorised and Non-Retail FMEs may use their own site or a page on the parent's site; Retail FMEs need their own site.
The site shows the FME's profile, registration number, address and schemes.
New FMEs comply before starting and send the URL within 30 days of registration.

fme.text: Publish the website or webpage by 01-12-2026.

actions: Prepare the disclosures and go live before 01-12-2026.

updates.title: IFSCA market abuse regulations replace SEBI insider trading and PFUTP rules in the IFSC
updates.applies: Listed entities, designated persons, intermediaries and investors on IFSC markets.
changes: Ban on communicating or trading on material non-public information.
Designated persons disclose trades within 2 trading days once quarterly trades exceed USD 25,000.
Trading plans disclosed 120 days ahead.
SEBI PIT Regulations, 2015 and PFUTP Regulations, 2003 no longer apply in the IFSC.

cmi.text: Update insider trading codes, designated person lists and disclosure processes.

fme.text: Fund managers trading listed IFSC securities must follow the new rules.

actions: Replace references to the SEBI PIT Regulations in IFSC policies.
Set up trade disclosure for designated persons.

updates.title: Every IFSC entity must hold a valid SEZ Letter of Approval at all times
updates.applies: All regulated entities.
changes: Hold a valid SEZ Letter of Approval and the IFSCA registration at all times.
Apply for renewal at least 2 months before expiry.
Replaces the directions of 03-04-2025.

ibu.text: Track the Letter of Approval expiry date; a lapse can lead to penalty, suspension or cancellation.

fc.text: Track the Letter of Approval expiry date; a lapse can lead to penalty, suspension or cancellation.

fme.text: Track the Letter of Approval expiry date; a lapse can lead to penalty, suspension or cancellation.

cmi.text: Track the Letter of Approval expiry date; a lapse can lead to penalty, suspension or cancellation.

ins.text: Track the Letter of Approval expiry date; a lapse can lead to penalty, suspension or cancellation.

actions: Diarise the Letter of Approval renewal at least 2 months before expiry.

updates.title: Internet banking deadline for IBUs extended to 30-09-2026; onboarding bar from 01-10-2026
updates.applies: IBUs offering liability products.
changes: One-time extension of the internet banking deadline to 30-09-2026.
From 01-10-2026, an IBU that has not complied stops onboarding new customers for that liability product.

ibu.text: Complete the internet banking features or stop onboarding new deposit customers from 01-10-2026.

actions: Confirm the dashboard and transactional features are live.

updates.title: Capital relief for factoring exposures covered by eligible credit protection
updates.applies: Factors and Banking Units with factoring exposures.
changes: The protected portion takes the risk weight of the protection provider.
Eligible providers include sovereigns, export credit agencies, MDBs, banks, regulated financial institutions, IFSC insurance offices and import factors.

fc.text: Lower capital on covered factoring exposures if the conditions are met.

ibu.text: Same for Banking Units doing factoring.

actions: Check credit protection contracts against the qualifying conditions.

updates.title: Internet banking for IBUs: deadline 31-07-2026 and clarifications
updates.applies: IBUs offering liability products.
changes: "All linked accounts" covers deposit and loan accounts.
Live rates on the dashboard are not mandatory.

ibu.text: Include loan accounts in the dashboard.

updates.title: IFSCA (Managing General Agents) Regulations, 2026
updates.applies: Managing general agents acting from the IFSC for foreign insurers.
changes: Foreign insurer net worth of at least USD 100 million.
MGA capital of USD 500,000 held with an IBU, net worth of USD 250,000 or 50% of capital, whichever is higher, and a lien-marked deposit of USD 10,000 plus 10% of the minimum capital.
Binding authority agreement, fiduciary premium accounts and referral of claims above USD 10,000 to the insurer.

ins.text: New registration route and conditions for MGAs.

ibu.text: IBUs hold MGA capital and lien-marked deposits.

actions: Check binding authority agreements against the regulations.

updates.title: Annual compliance audit report and certificate for CMIs by 30 September
updates.applies: Capital market intermediaries.
changes: Submit the annual compliance audit report and certificate by email by 30 September, starting with FY 2025-26.
Broker dealers, clearing members and depository participants also file with the market infrastructure institutions.

cmi.text: Appoint the auditor in time to file by 30 September.

actions: Book the compliance audit for FY 2025-26.

updates.title: Regulated entities encouraged to publish a Consumer Charter
updates.applies: Regulated entities dealing with retail consumers.
changes: Entities dealing with retail consumers are encouraged to publish a Consumer Charter.

ibu.text: Consider publishing a Consumer Charter if you serve retail consumers.

fc.text: Consider publishing a Consumer Charter if you serve retail consumers.

fme.text: Consider publishing a Consumer Charter if you serve retail consumers.

cmi.text: Consider publishing a Consumer Charter if you serve retail consumers.

ins.text: Consider publishing a Consumer Charter if you serve retail consumers.

updates.title: Finance Company Regulations amended (May 2026)
updates.applies: Finance Companies and Finance Units.
changes: Defines a Special Purpose Vehicle: a finance company incorporated or administered by a Trust and Company Service Provider authorised under the TechFin and Ancillary Services Regulations, 2025.
Leasing or financing by an SPV is added as a permitted activity, with an owned fund requirement linked to the Companies Act minimum.

fc.text: Leasing groups using SPVs can register them under the amended regulations.

updates.title: Scheme fiduciaries may not also provide administration, valuation, audit or loans to the scheme
updates.applies: FMEs and the trustees, boards or designated partners of their schemes.
changes: A fiduciary may not provide fund administration, valuation, audit or lending to the same scheme, directly or through an associate.
Existing schemes comply by 30-09-2026.

fme.text: Restructure service arrangements where a fiduciary or its associate also serves the scheme.

actions: Map fiduciaries and their associates against service providers for each scheme.

updates.title: New reporting norms for capital market intermediaries
updates.applies: Capital market intermediaries.
changes: Quarterly reports within 21 calendar days of quarter end.
Half-yearly AML compliance sheet.
Replaces the norms of 08-02-2024.
actions: Diarise quarterly filings for the 21st day after quarter end.

updates.title: Certification course specified for FME KMPs and employees; KMP intimation process amended
updates.applies: Fund management entities and their KMPs and employees.
changes: IFSCA specified a certification course (offered by ICSI; ICAI added on 10-08-2026).
The KMP circular of 20-02-2025 was amended to remove the 7-working-day comment period.

fme.text: Plan certification for KMPs and staff.

updates.title: Three-year relief from parts of the cyber security guidelines for branches and small entities
updates.applies: Branches of regulated entities, group-only entities such as global in-house centres, and entities with fewer than 10 employees.
changes: Eligible entities adopt the parent's framework, with the parent CISO as designated officer.
They file a compliance certificate within 90 days of year end and still submit the annual audit.

ibu.text: Check whether you qualify for the relief and file the certificate.

fc.text: Check whether you qualify for the relief and file the certificate.

fme.text: Check whether you qualify for the relief and file the certificate.

cmi.text: Check whether you qualify for the relief and file the certificate.

ins.text: Check whether you qualify for the relief and file the certificate.

updates.title: New IFSCA fee structure
updates.applies: All applicants and regulated entities.
changes: Application, registration, flat recurring and conditional recurring fees, with interest on delay.
Flat recurring fee due 1 April and payable by 30 April.
Replaces earlier fee circulars, including that of 08-04-2025.

ibu.text: Pay the recurring fee by 30 April each year.

fc.text: Pay the recurring fee by 30 April each year.

fme.text: Pay the recurring fee by 30 April each year.

cmi.text: Pay the recurring fee by 30 April each year.

ins.text: Pay the recurring fee by 30 April each year.

actions: Diarise the annual fee for 30 April.

updates.title: SWIFT naming, routing and broadcast requirements for IBUs
updates.applies: IBUs using SWIFT.
changes: BIC name to include "GIFT IFSC Banking Unit".
Routing rules for misdirected messages and a quarterly broadcast for one year.
Compliance report by 30-06-2026.

ibu.text: Update the BIC name and routing rules.

updates.title: Unified registration for several capital market activities
updates.applies: Applicants for more than one capital market activity.
changes: One application through the Single Window IT System for several activities, with a fee for each.

updates.title: Finance companies serving outside clients must keep a website from 01-04-2026
updates.applies: Finance Companies and Finance Units serving clients outside their group.
changes: Show the certificate of registration, products, grievance procedure and KMP contacts.
